name: Attach an executable provenance path to each reported result
evidence: Sandve recommends recording full workflows and exact inputs, versions and parameters, preferably as executable specifications.

operational_primitive.transformation: Map the result to a versioned executable workflow and preserve its execution context.

constraints: Logs may omit human choices; executable provenance does not validate scientific assumptions.
reuse_hypothesis: Map selected manuscript results to compact evidence records rather than asking reviewers to read full agent transcripts.
next_test: Have one colleague reconstruct one existing figure from its provenance record; log ambiguities and required human explanations.
word_count_convention: Whitespace-separated tokens in recursive string values; excludes word_count and this convention; excludes JSON keys.
